# gcore_cdn_applied_preset (Resource)

Applied presets represent the association between a preset and a CDN resource or rule. Use them to apply a preset to an object, list the objects a preset is applied to, unapply it, and inspect which object fields a preset manages.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gcore_cdn_applied_preset" "example_cdn_applied_preset" {
  preset_id = 0
  object_id = 7531
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `object_id` (Number) ID of the object (CDN resource or rule, according to the preset `object_type`) to apply the preset to.
- `preset_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) ID of the object (CDN resource or rule, according to the preset `object_type`) to apply the preset to.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import gcore_cdn_applied_preset.example '<preset_id>/<object_id>'
```
